title: Daily Market Digest
subtitle: September 23, 2026 - As of late trading today

items.headline: U.S. Stocks Decline Amid Inflation Worries, Rising Oil Prices, and Treasury Yields
items.summary: U.S. equities are broadly lower in late trading today as a surge in crude oil prices and climbing Treasury yields rekindle inflation and borrowing-cost concerns. A surprisingly strong report on U.S. business activity also contributed to worries about intensified price pressures. Investors are closely monitoring diplomatic talks between the U.S. and Iran, and an upcoming summit between President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. Not financial advice.

items.headline: IonQ Jumps on Quantum Error Correction Breakthrough
items.summary: Shares of IonQ ($IONQ) climbed 5% today after the quantum computing company announced the development and testing of a real-time quantum error correction decoder.

items.headline: Cracker Barrel Soars After Beating Earnings Estimates
items.summary: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store ($CBRL) surged 8.3% to $49.25 after reporting fiscal fourth-quarter results that topped Wall Street's expectations.

items.headline: Worthington Enterprises Up on Strong Q1 FY2027 Results
items.summary: Worthington Enterprises ($WOR) saw its shares rise 2% following an upbeat Q1 FY2027 report, with revenue increasing 13.2% year-over-year and organic growth reaching 7%.

items.headline: Jaguar Health Plummets
items.summary: Jaguar Health, Inc. ($JAGX) shares experienced a significant drop today, falling 62.28% to $13.00. No specific news was immediately available for the sharp decline.

items.headline: Adagio Medical Holdings Sees Steep Decline
items.summary: Adagio Medical Holdings, Inc. ($ADGM) fell sharply today by 40.27% to $0.290. No specific news was immediately available for the movement.

items.headline: IM Cannabis Corp. Drops
items.summary: IM Cannabis Corp. ($IMCC) shares declined 31.16% to $2.850 today.

items.headline: Consumer Lending Stocks Slide on Credit Risk Repricing
items.summary: Consumer lending companies like Upstart Holdings ($UPST), Affirm Holdings ($AFRM), and SoFi Technologies ($SOFI) saw declines of 4%, 4%, and 2% respectively, attributed to a repricing of consumer credit risk.

items.headline: Technology and Consumer Staples Led Tuesday's Gains, Financials Lagging Today
items.summary: On Tuesday, the Information Technology Select Sector SPDR ($XLK) rose 0.7%, and the Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR ($XLP) added 1%. However, financial stocks, including major banks, are under pressure today with the Financials Select Sector SPDR ($XLF) declining 2% on Tuesday, due to concerns that Meta's new AI assistant 'Muse' could lead to consumers seeking cheaper alternatives for financial services.

items.headline: U.S. Business Activity Surges to Five-Year High, Raising Inflation Concerns
items.summary: A preliminary report indicated that U.S. business activity in September surged to its strongest level in over five years, with the S&P Global's composite Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) rising to 58.4 from 56.0 in August. This robust economic data, coupled with increased input prices, has intensified worries about inflation and its potential impact on interest rates.

items.headline: Federal Reserve's Recent Rate Hike Impacts Market Sentiment
items.summary: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates last week (September 16, 2026) to a target range of 3.75%-4.00%, the first increase since 2023, in an ongoing effort to combat elevated inflation. This move is contributing to the current market pressure as higher rates typically increase borrowing costs and can weigh on economically sensitive sectors.

items.headline: U.S.-Iran Diplomatic Talks and U.S.-China Summit in Focus
items.summary: Markets are keenly watching diplomatic developments, including ongoing talks between U.S. and Iranian officials, which President Trump described as a 'very good meeting'. Additionally, President Trump is preparing to host Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington later this week for discussions on trade and broader economic issues.

items.headline: U.S. Government Fiscal Picture Worsens, Debt Exceeds $40 Trillion
items.summary: The U.S. government is projected to overspend by more than $2 trillion in its 2026 fiscal year, with the total public debt outstanding surpassing $40 trillion. This escalating debt, partly driven by increased interest payment costs, is a significant macro trend affecting markets.

items.headline: Cintas Reports Strong Q1, General Mills and Others Expected to Report
items.summary: Cintas Corporation ($CTAS) reported strong Q1 fiscal 2027 results with revenue up 10.9% and diluted EPS increasing by 13.3%. Cracker Barrel ($CBRL) and Worthington Enterprises ($WOR) also announced upbeat earnings today. General Mills ($GIS) and Paychex ($PAYX) are among several other major companies expected to report earnings today.
